items.name: West Coast Cubing Tour - Reno 2018

venue.name: University of Nevada, Reno
venue.address: Mathewson-IGT Knowledge Center, 1664 N Virginia St Reno, NV 89512
venue.details: Wells Fargo Auditorium, on the ground floor of the Mathewson-IGT Knowledge Center.

items.information: Join us in the Biggest Little City in the World for the Reno installment of the West Coast Cubing Tour! ### This competition is on a Wednesday. ### There is no 3x3x3 being held. ### All competitors under the age of 18 must bring a signed waiver, [available here](https://drive.google.com/file/d/0B8p_ji-LnWOER1h5NDVpSXF3MzE2TWlyZW9TMWlmeXJzLUVz/view?usp=sharing). Hosted by Reno Rubik's Cube Club at the University of Nevada, Reno.
